newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Wednesday's close, slaughter steers and heifers not well established with few sales $0.50 per cwt higher, USDA said.
Trade slow to moderate. Demand moderate to good. Seller interest moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1250 lbs few 65.75-66.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1075 lbs 2 ld 65.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers 1.00 higher in a light test.

Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1200 lbs few 107.00-108.00.
